title: Sell These $3.5K AI Pitch Decks Built in 12 Min (+4 More Ideas)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

speakers.name: Nick
speakers.role: co-host/guest, Nickonomics podcast and creator (~3M followers)

idea.name: Automated AI pitch decks for newly launched funds
idea.one_liner: Scrape SEC filings for new funds, auto-generate a tailored watermarked deck via the Manus API, find contacts with Apollo and cold-email the first five slides offering the full deck for sale, modelled on the Pitch Deck Guy's $3,500 service
idea.customer: newly launched investment funds and syndicators needing investor decks

key_quotes.quote: He goes and he scrapes like the filings, SEC filings, when people launch a new fund or anything, you know, people that are about to need a really nice pitch deck.
Would you like to buy this? Here's the first five slides." That could be fully automated as of today.
It worked for 12 minutes and 31 seconds and it spit out this 12 slides.

claims.claim: The Pitch Deck Guy charges $3,500 per deck
claims.quote: Here's my portfolio." What does he charge?

claims.claim: Manus produced an editable 12-slide PowerPoint in ~12.5 minutes from a one-line prompt
claims.quote: It's spit it out as a PPT, as a PowerPoint.

acquisition_channels.details: Apollo contact lookup, watermarked preview deck emailed to fund managers triggered by SEC filings

ideas.delivery: Gumloop/Lindy/Zapier automation: SEC filings scrape -> Manus API deck -> email
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR legitimate-interest assessment for B2B cold email (corporate subscribers, PECR soft rules); FCA financial promotion rules if decks promote investments

idea.name: Redesign newly uploaded SlideShare decks and sell them back
idea.one_liner: Automatically restyle every new SlideShare upload with AI and offer the creator the improved version for $20-200
idea.customer: people and companies uploading decks to SlideShare

key_quotes.quote: Like create a permissionless thing that anytime a new slide is uploaded to Slides Share, you revamp it, you redesign it.

claims.claim: SlideShare gets 5-10 million visits a month
claims.quote: They get it's either five or 10 million visits a month.

acquisition_channels.details: send redesigned deck back to the original uploader

uk_legal_risk.reason: Unsolicited electronic marketing to individual uploaders needs consent under PECR

idea.name: Convert teachers' lesson plans into slide decks
idea.one_liner: Mass-message Teachers Pay Teachers sellers (and church teachers) offering to turn their lesson plans or outlines into PowerPoint decks they can sell alongside
idea.customer: Teachers Pay Teachers sellers, Sunday-school teachers
idea.offer: AI-generated presentation from a lesson plan

key_quotes.quote: You could go on there and like DM, mass DM all the teachers that are selling lesson plans and say, "Hey, why don't you sell a pitch deck alongside the lesson plan?"

acquisition_channels.details: mass DMs to Teachers Pay Teachers sellers

uk_legal_risk.reason: Mass unsolicited DMs to individual teacher-sellers (sole traders) breach PECR consent rules

idea.name: Culture-fit quiz recruiting and placement
idea.one_liner: Have hiring managers take a long Typeform-style culture quiz that scores their ideal hire, have job seekers take a matching quiz, then send managers candidates with matching scores and charge a placement fee
idea.revenue_model: recruiter-style placement fee (10-30% of first-year salary)

key_quotes.quote: Like we're talking 30% of first year salary, 10 to 30%.
Let's say you set up an automation to message everyone on LinkedIn that is in HR in hiring.
Hey, your perfect score of a perfect candidate is an 87. Look at these 87s that we just found that just filled out the same form, right?

acquisition_channels.details: automated LinkedIn messages to HR/hiring staff inviting them to take the company-culture quiz

ideas.delivery: ChatGPT-generated quizzes built in Lovable/Typeform; matching on numerical score
ideas.other_uk_rules: Employment agency rules (Conduct of Employment Agencies Regulations 2003); Equality Act 2010 risk from personality-based screening; UK GDPR for candidate profiling

idea.name: White-label hiring culture quizzes as a talent lead magnet
idea.one_liner: Build companies (or creators with big audiences) a branded culture-fit quiz that gates results behind email, building a scored candidate list to query whenever a role opens
idea.customer: companies and creators who hire regularly
idea.offer: custom AI-built hiring quiz and candidate database

key_quotes.quote: So, that would be like an internal thing that pretty much any company pretty easily could create a rapper that would do that.
You've got 10,000 people who filled out the survey with an email address that you can go at any time now to query if you're looking for a position.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR and Equality Act 2010 for candidate profiling

idea.name: Give-to-get AI use-case community and newsletter
idea.one_liner: HowDoYouUseAI.com: visitors must submit how they use AI before they can see and upvote others' use cases, with a weekly email of the top five
idea.customer: people curious how others use AI
idea.offer: crowdsourced AI use-case feed and weekly newsletter

key_quotes.quote: But you can only see everyone else's use cases once you submit your own use case.
And then they can subscribe to be notified of all the top upvoted ways people are using AI every week.

acquisition_channels.details: exact-match domain on a rising Google Trends query

idea.name: Email-gated AI quiz lead magnets
idea.one_liner: Turn proprietary interview data into a ChatGPT-designed, Lovable-built quiz (e.g. which LLM fits your business) that requires an email to see results
idea.revenue_model: email list building for downstream offers

key_quotes.quote: Of course, I got to have a gating mechanism. You got to put in your email if you want to see your score.

claims.claim: First quiz took a couple of hours, now about an hour
claims.quote: So, this was the first time I did it. So, it took me a couple of hours.

idea.name: AI-generated industry reports as B2B lead magnets
idea.one_liner: Use Perplexity Labs to produce tailored market reports (charts, CSVs, sources) for every prospect on an agency's or supplier's list, e.g. local market reports for HVAC owners, and email them to open conversations
idea.customer: digital agencies, consultants and B2B suppliers (e.g. HVAC supply) prospecting business owners
idea.offer: free custom industry/market report leading to a service sale
idea.revenue_model: supports retainers or product sales; implicit report service

key_quotes.quote: If they use this and they generated a report for every company that's on their list, cuz every every one of these businesses has like an ideal customer.
We talked about this before, IBIS World, where I work, they're charging $2,000 reports.
Why don't you just send an industry report for their specific market to every single HVAC owner?

claims.quote: You do have to have the $20 a month Perplexity plan, but at first I was like, "Oh, this is just deep research."

acquisition_channels.details: emailed report with open tracking and follow-up

uk_legal_risk.reason: Cold emails to sole-trader HVAC owners require consent under PECR
